+name: Selection authority evidence
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - 'apps/web/**'
+      - 'packages/design-system/**'
+      - 'packages/workspace/**'
+      - 'packages/model-renderer/**'
+      - 'packages/plan-renderer/**'
+      - 'scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/selection-authority-state-flow.test.mjs'
+      - '.github/workflows/selection-authority-evidence.yml'
+      - 'docs/product/ARQ-UI-UX-SELECTION-FOCUS-AUTHORITY-MAP.md'
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - 'apps/web/**'
+      - 'packages/design-system/**'
+      - 'packages/workspace/**'
+      - 'packages/model-renderer/**'
+      - 'packages/plan-renderer/**'
+      - 'scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs'
+      - 'scripts/selection-authority-state-flow.test.mjs'
+      - '.github/workflows/selection-authority-evidence.yml'
+      - 'docs/product/ARQ-UI-UX-SELECTION-FOCUS-AUTHORITY-MAP.md'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+concurrency:
+  group: selection-authority-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  browser-selection-authority:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: 20
+          cache: pnpm
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - name: Prepare #401 browser probe with multi-select delegated to state-flow evidence
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+
+          probe = Path('scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs')
+          text = probe.read_text()
+          start_marker = '  /* 5. Multi-select: marquee first result is primary, remainder secondary. */\n'
+          end_marker = '  await tab3d.click();\n  await model.waitFor({ state: \'visible\', timeout: 5000 });\n  observed.afterDelete3d = await waitForGreenSelection(page, model, false);\n'
+          start = text.find(start_marker)
+          end = text.find(end_marker, start)
+          if start < 0 or end < 0:
+              raise SystemExit('expected multi-select/delete browser block was not found')
+          replacement = """  /* 5. Multi-select is proven by deterministic state-flow evidence. */
+  observed.multiSelection = {
+    evidence: 'state-flow',
+    selectorTest: 'apps/web/src/canvas/canvas-interaction.test.ts',
+    authorityTest: 'scripts/selection-authority-state-flow.test.mjs',
+  };
+
+  /* 4. Delete one selected target -> stale selection is cleared. */
+  const drawnBeforeDelete = await drawnRows.count();
+  await drawnRows.nth(0).click();
+  const deleteSelectedId = await inspectorId(page);
+  const context = page.getByRole('toolbar', { name: 'Context actions' });
+  await context.waitFor({ state: 'visible', timeout: 5000 });
+  await context.getByRole('button', { name: /Delete/ }).click();
+  await page.waitForFunction(
+    (expectedDrawnCount) =>
+      document.querySelectorAll('[role="treeitem"][aria-selected="true"]').length === 0 &&
+      [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="treeitem"]')].filter((row) =>
+        /\(drawn\)/.test(row.textContent ?? ''),
+      ).length === expectedDrawnCount,
+    drawnBeforeDelete - 1,
+    { timeout: 5000 },
+  );
+  await assertNoSelection(page, 'delete-selected');
+  observed.deleteClearsSelection = {
+    deletedId: deleteSelectedId,
+    remainingDrawnWalls: drawnBeforeDelete - 1,
+  };
+
+"""
+          text = text[:start] + replacement + text[end:]
+          probe.write_text(text)
+          PY
+          pnpm exec prettier --write scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs
+      - name: Persist browser/state-flow split on the PR branch
+        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
+        run: |
+          if ! git diff --quiet -- scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs; then
+            git stash push -- scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs
+            git fetch origin "${{ github.head_ref }}"
+            git checkout -B "${{ github.head_ref }}" "origin/${{ github.head_ref }}"
+            git stash pop
+            git config user.name github-actions[bot]
+            git config user.email 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
+            git add scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs
+            git commit -m "test(ux): move #401 multi-selection to deterministic state-flow evidence"
+            git push origin "${{ github.head_ref }}"
+          fi
+      - name: Verify #401 evidence files are formatted
+        run: >-
+          pnpm exec prettier --check
+          scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs
+          scripts/selection-authority-state-flow.test.mjs
+          docs/product/ARQ-UI-UX-SELECTION-FOCUS-AUTHORITY-MAP.md
+          .github/workflows/selection-authority-evidence.yml
+      - name: Verify multi-selection state flow
+        run: |
+          node scripts/selection-authority-state-flow.test.mjs
+          pnpm --filter @arq/web exec vitest run src/canvas/canvas-interaction.test.ts
+      - name: Compile Zeus task context for #401
+        run: >-
+          node scripts/zeus.mjs compile --task
+          "Finish ARQ issue #401 by validating selection, focus and interaction-state authority across Plan, 3D, tree and inspector at current exact head. Add deterministic evidence only. Do not redesign selection."
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: node scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: selection-authority-evidence
+          path: benchmarks/results/selection-authority.*

Related to #401. The issue will be closed only after post-merge exact-head evidence is green.

## Scope

Audit/evidence only. No selection redesign and no new state store.

- revalidates `docs/product/ARQ-UI-UX-SELECTION-FOCUS-AUTHORITY-MAP.md` against current `main`
- adds `scripts/run-selection-authority-capability-check.mjs` covering all eight #401 state-flow/browser scenarios

- leaves `apps/web/src/App.tsx` untouched because PR #361 remains its active owner
- records `WorkspaceModeState.selection` as an already-divergent but dormant duplicate representation and routes architectural correction to #425

## Required evidence

The probe must prove Plan/tree/3D/inspector projection, view-switch continuity, delete self-healing, primary/secondary multi-selection, level-switch clearing, DOM-focus independence, and the current Escape-versus-clear ordering.

Do not merge on a red focused probe. Any runtime contradiction belongs in the audit/issue and, where architectural, in #425 rather than being hidden by a selection redesign here.
